targets.queryText: SELECT started_at as Inizio, ended_at as Fine, charge_type as Tipo, ROUND(start_soc,0) as "SOC iniziale", ROUND(end_soc,0) as "SOC finale", ROUND(energy_added_kwh,1) as kWh, ROUND(cost,2) as Costo, ROUND(max_power_kw,1) as "Potenza max (kW)", COALESCE(station_name, location_name, '-') as Luogo FROM charges WHERE id = $charge_id
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT started_at as Inizio, ended_at as Fine, charge_type as Tipo, ROUND(start_soc,0) as "SOC iniziale", ROUND(end_soc,0) as "SOC finale", ROUND(energy_added_kwh,1) as kWh, ROUND(cost,2) as Costo, ROUND(max_power_kw,1) as "Potenza max (kW)", COALESCE(station_name, location_name, '-') as Luogo FROM charges WHERE id = $charge_id

targets.queryText: WITH dur AS (SELECT MAX((julianday(c.ended_at)-julianday(c.started_at))*1440.0/60.0, 1.0) as bin_min FROM charges c WHERE c.id = $charge_id) SELECT CAST((julianday(p.recorded_at) - julianday(c.started_at)) * 1440 / (SELECT bin_min FROM dur) AS INT) || '' as minuti, ROUND(AVG(ABS(p.charge_voltage_v * p.charge_current_a)/1000.0),3) as kW FROM positions p, charges c WHERE c.id = $charge_id AND p.charging = 1 AND p.recorded_at >= c.started_at AND p.recorded_at <= COALESCE(c.ended_at, datetime('now')) GROUP BY CAST((julianday(p.recorded_at) - julianday(c.started_at)) * 1440 / (SELECT bin_min FROM dur) AS INT) ORDER BY MIN(p.recorded_at)

targets.queryText: WITH dur AS (SELECT MAX((julianday(c.ended_at)-julianday(c.started_at))*1440.0/60.0, 1.0) as bin_min FROM charges c WHERE c.id = $charge_id) SELECT CAST((julianday(p.recorded_at) - julianday(c.started_at)) * 1440 / (SELECT bin_min FROM dur) AS INT) || '' as minuti, ROUND(AVG(p.soc),1) as soc FROM positions p, charges c WHERE c.id = $charge_id AND p.charging = 1 AND p.recorded_at >= c.started_at AND p.recorded_at <= COALESCE(c.ended_at, datetime('now')) GROUP BY CAST((julianday(p.recorded_at) - julianday(c.started_at)) * 1440 / (SELECT bin_min FROM dur) AS INT) ORDER BY MIN(p.recorded_at)

list.query: SELECT id as __value, started_at || ' - ' || ROUND(energy_added_kwh,1) || ' kWh (' || charge_type || ')' as __text FROM charges WHERE energy_added_kwh IS NOT NULL ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 60
